description: This file contains a set of unit tests for Orleans stream reliability features, including tests for silo restarts, silo failures, stream subscriptions, pub/sub mechanisms, and consumer/producer interactions. It defines the class 'StreamReliabilityTests' with multiple test cases and utility methods to manage and verify Orleans grains, silos, and stream behaviors.

classes.name: StreamReliabilityTests
classes.description: A suite of async unit tests for verifying Orleans stream reliability under different scenarios such as silo restarts, failures, and grain dynamics. It configures a test cluster, manages grains and silos, and verifies stream message delivery and pub/sub behaviors.

methods.name: Do_BaselineTest
methods.description: Initializes a producer and consumer grain with a specific stream, verifies connectivity, and sends messages to test baseline stream behavior.

methods.name: Do_AddConsumerGrains
methods.description: Creates multiple consumer grains on the same or different silos, pings them, and adds them as consumers to a stream.

methods.name: Test_AddMany_Consumers
methods.description: Tests adding multiple consumer grains dynamically and verifies message reception counts.

methods.name: Test_PubSub_MultiConsumerSameGrain
methods.description: Tests pub/sub subscription with multiple consumers on the same grain.

methods.name: Test_PubSub_MultiProducerSameGrain
methods.description: Tests pub/sub with multiple producers on the same grain.

methods.name: Test_PubSub_Unsubscribe
methods.description: Tests subscribing and unsubscribing from streams, verifying pub/sub handling.

methods.name: Test_AllSilosRestart
methods.description: Simulates restarting all silos and verifies message delivery and pub/sub counts post-restart.

methods.name: Test_SiloDies_Consumer
methods.description: Kills the silo containing the consumer grain and verifies message flow continues.

methods.name: Test_SiloDies_Producer
methods.description: Kills the silo containing the producer grain and verifies message flow continues.

methods.name: Test_SiloRestarts_Consumer
methods.description: Restarts silo hosting the consumer grain and checks message delivery.

methods.name: Test_SiloRestarts_Producer
methods.description: Restarts silo hosting the producer grain and checks message flow.

methods.name: Test_SiloJoins
methods.description: Adds a new silo to the cluster and verifies grains on the new silo can join and receive messages.

methods.name: RestartAllSilos
methods.description: Restarts all silos in the cluster to simulate failure and recovery scenarios.

methods.name: StopSilo
methods.description: Stops or kills a specific silo, with options to restart, used for failure injection.

methods.name: GetGrain
methods.description: Returns a grain instance of 'IStreamReliabilityTestGrain' given an ID.

methods.name: CreateGrainOnSilo
methods.description: Creates a grain on a specific silo, by locating a grain on that silo.

methods.name: CheckConsumerProducerStatus
methods.description: Verifies that grains are correctly reporting as consumer/producer with expected counts.

methods.name: CheckReceivedCounts
methods.description: Checks that a consumer grain has received the expected number of messages and errors.

methods.name: CheckConsumerCounts
methods.description: Verifies the number of consumer handles registered with a consumer grain.
